Applied verifier fix only: added human verifier H8 for the ungraded handover note and pinned concrete numbers/filenames into A2/A5/A8; bleed and deliverable fixes did not apply to PHOTO-22.

Closed the one named verifier gap by adding H8 for the handover-note contents and pinned exact numbers into A6/A8/A9; bleed and deliverable fixes did not apply, and the banned-generative_expand + PDF-asset audit issues were left untouched as outside these three fix categories.

Fixed the A2 verifier (unsatisfiable tile count + vague size pinned to six 2000x2000px tiles with a deterministic how) and scoped the over-broad Deliverable 3 to the six SKUs with real part frames, folding the rest into SKU reconciliation across acceptance_bar/trajectory/why_not_vlm; no bleed over-claim existed so the bleed fix did not apply.

None of the three spec-level fixes apply to PHOTO-27, so the spec JSON was left unchanged: (A) verifiers — all three verifier flags are true and verifier_issue praises them as strong with complete deliverable/checkpoint coverage; (B) bleed — every bleed mention is already honest (trim-only delivery plus explicit no-bleed shortfall disclosure, no press-ready-with-bleed over-claim to rewrite); (C) deliverable — PHOTO-27 is not PHOTO-25. Applied verifier fix (A) only to PHOTO-29: tightened A10 to grade the handover note's 'what to watch when the board edits' item plus made A6 and A8 concrete/deterministic; bleed and deliverable fixes did not apply.

Applied the verifier fix only: pinned exact numbers in A10 (supplier physical dims) and A12 (15 cards, archived Ruelle Chain), and split A13's OCR-dependent read into a deterministic filename check (A13, auto) plus a new visual-read human verifier (H9); bleed was already honest (trim-only) and the deliverable fix is PHOTO-25-only, so neither applied.
